deadly.question: I am full of holes but stronger than a bull.
I am tough as nails yet cannot endure the sun.
I have a spine but no bones.
I grow up while growing down.
I connect two, but touch only one.
I may finish a book without finishing a sentence.
I am the beginning of every end and the end of time and space.

easy.question: What has keys but can't open locks?
What has a heart that doesn't beat?
I am always hungry, I must always be fed. The finger I touch will soon turn red.
The person who buys it never uses it. The person who uses it never knows they're using it.
What has to be broken before you can use it?
What begins with T, ends with T, and has T in it?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind.
The more of this there is, the less you see.
What can run but never walks, has a mouth but never talks, has a head but never weeps, has a bed but never sleeps?
What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
I have many needles but never sew.
What goes up but never comes down?
I begin without ending and am the ending of all beginnings.
Easy to lift and hard to throw.

hard.question: You can hold me in your left hand, but never your right.
What comes down but never goes up?
I look through walls but never see. I sanctify when stained.
What can you break, even if you never pick it up or touch it?
What has a tongue that cannot taste, eyes that cannot see, and a soul that cannot die?
I am always in front of you but can never be seen.
I fill a room but take up no space.
Sometimes narrow, sometimes wide, wind or rain, I stay outside
The more you take from me, the bigger I become. What am I?
There is one in every corner and two in every room.

medium.question: What has a neck but no head, two arms but no hands?
What comes once in a year, twice in a week, but never in a day?
Once I am caught, you only want to be rid of me.
I turn once, what is out will not get in. I turn again, what is in will not get out.
What can fill a room but takes up no space?
What is seen in the middle of March and April that can't be seen at the beginning or end of either month?
What flies without wings and cries without eyes?
The more you take, the more you leave behind.
What has roots as nobody sees, Is taller than trees, Up, up it goes, And yet it never grows?
What has a bottom at the top?
I'm quick when I'm thin and slow when I'm fat. The wind is my enemy.
I disappear when you say my name.
I lie behind the stars and underneath the ancient hills. I always come first and yet follow after, end every life and silence laughter.
What has four fingers and a thumb but is not alive?
You can keep me only once you give me away.
What has a head, a tail, is brown, and has no legs?
I am taken from a mine and shut up in a wooden case, from which I am never released, and yet I am used by almost every person.
What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
What can travel around the world while staying in the same spot?
What has one eye but can't see?
What has many teeth but can't bite?
What has hands but can't clap?
What has a neck but no head?
What has an eye but cannot see?
What can you catch but not throw?
What breaks but never falls?
What goes through cities and fields, but never moves?
I always was, yet never will be.
I travel the world, yet stay in a corner.
